ecb.label: European Central Bank
ecb.description: EURIBOR published by the ECB, monthly from January 1999.

snapshot.label: Built-in rate data
snapshot.description: EURIBOR bundled with the app. Works offline and is at most a month behind.

manual.label: Rates I enter myself
manual.description: For a reference rate the app cannot fetch, or figures taken from your own statements.

provider.privacyNote: Rate requests ask only for a public interest-rate series. They contain nothing about you or your loan.

forecast.title: Rates from {{period}} onwards
forecast.explanation: Nobody knows what rates will do. Pick an assumption and the projection will say which one it used.
forecast.HOLD_LAST_help: The latest published rate continues unchanged.
forecast.SHOCK_help: The latest rate plus or minus a set number of basis points.
forecast.FIXED_help: A flat rate for every future month.
forecast.CURVE_help: Enter rates for specific months; the last one carries on from there.

sensitivity.title: If rates move
sensitivity.explanation: What each instalment and the total interest would become at different rates.

status.usingSnapshotBecause: Could not reach the ECB, so the built-in data is being used instead.
status.missingRate: No published rate for {{period}}. Choose what to assume for months beyond the published data.
